mapper.select:
select user_id,u.name userName, sum(inspection_quantity) inspectionQuantity FROM mes_building_produce_inspection_team_report r inner join sys_user u on u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.bool_delete_enum = 0
and r.product_type = #{productType}
AND r.in_year_month_day_date >= date_format(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND r.in_year_month_day_date <= date_format(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
group by user_id,u.name
